# The Conscious Collective Inc.

> Human-centred fractional HR consulting, executive leadership coaching, relationship coaching (Conscious Coupling™), and organizational workshops across Alberta and Canada. Founded by Sheri MacLeod.

## Primary Services
- [Organizations & Fractional HR](https://theconsciouscollective.ca/organizations): Senior people strategy, workplace culture advisory, compensation frameworks, and fractional People & Culture leadership for small to mid-sized businesses.
- [Individuals & Relationship Coaching](https://theconsciouscollective.ca/individuals): Conscious Coupling™ relationship coaching, executive performance, and personal growth for high-impact leaders.
- [Speaking & Facilitation](https://theconsciouscollective.ca/facilitation): Strategic leadership retreats, candid team workshops, and keynote speaking.
- [About Sheri MacLeod](https://theconsciouscollective.ca/about): Background, leadership philosophy, credentials, and mission.
- [Contact & Booking](https://theconsciouscollective.ca/contact): Direct consultation booking, discovery calls, and contact details.
